verdict.rationale: Release notes describe an environment selector dropdown, now with a search filter, which implies you can switch between named environment variable sets. A CLI flag can override global environment variables at runtime, and secret variables keep credentials out of version control. The evidence is indirect release-note snippets, and one community comment only wishes for richer environment support without contradicting it. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing how to create and switch dev/staging/prod environments, details on per-environment variable scoping and overrides, and independent hands-on corroboration.
